title: Kansas City, MO neighborhoods
intro: From the River Market and Downtown to the Plaza, Brookside, and Waldo, these neighborhoods share a mix of historic brick homes, converted lofts, and early twentieth century apartment buildings. Older pipe is the common thread.

title: The Northland and Platte County
intro: North of the Missouri River, our service area runs from North Kansas City and Gladstone through Liberty, Smithville, Parkville, Riverside, and Claycomo. Homes here range from mid-century ranches to new subdivisions and lake properties.

title: Eastern Jackson County
intro: East of Kansas City along the I-70 and US-40 corridors, Raytown, Independence, Blue Springs, Lee's Summit, and Oak Grove combine some of the metro's oldest housing with its newest suburban growth.

title: South metro
intro: South of the city along the I-49 and US-71 corridor, Grandview and Belton mix post-war neighborhoods with newer construction on the edge of Cass County.
